en.site.title: ModernChat — The plugin-first web chat platform
en.site.desc: Out of the box: accounts and plain-text chat. Images, emoji, themes, bots and mini-games all come from pluggable JS plugins. Go + Vue 3, open source, self-hosted.
en.hero.sub: Out of the box you get plain accounts + plain-text chat. Images, emoji, Markdown, dark themes, bots, mini-games — every extra comes from pluggable JS plugins. Uninstall them and you are back to plain text.
en.hero.p1: Sandboxed plugin runtime: no DOM, no JWT, enabled only after you confirm the permission list
en.hero.p2: 10,000+ concurrent WebSocket connections per instance, end-to-end P99 < 100ms
en.hero.p3: One command with Docker Compose, one command to upgrade from Gitee
en.demo.title: Product Chat
en.demo.subtitle: 12 members · 3 online

en.features.title: Features
en.features.sub: A thin kernel, everything else is a plugin. These are the out-of-the-box kernel capabilities.
en.f1.d: Register / login / password recovery, bcrypt hashing, JWT with token_version for instant revocation, ban & force logout, custom avatars.
en.f2.d: WebSocket heartbeat + exponential-backoff reconnect, read receipts, 2-minute recall, typing indicator, presence, auto resync after reconnect.
en.f3.d: One conversation model: idempotent direct chats, group create / search / join / leave, kick & owner transfer, unread badges and list filters.
en.f4.d: Sandboxed iframes, declarative UI rendered by whitelist components, permission confirmation on install, same-name upload upgrades, admin global takedown.
en.f5.d: Ban / unban / random password reset, plugins aggregated by name with global takedown, build version at a glance.
en.f6.d: Structured daily-rotated logs, three-tier rate limiting (optional shared Redis quota), health & version endpoints, one-command upgrade from Gitee.
en.plugin.title: Plugins: one JS file extends the whole site
en.plugin.sub: Each plugin is a JS file (≤1MB) running in a sandbox iframe, talking to the host via postMessage. All UI is described as JSON and rendered by whitelist components.
en.plugin.s1: Plugins never touch the DOM, cannot read the JWT or host storage
en.plugin.s2: Permission list shown at install; enabled only after user confirmation
en.plugin.s3: Network requests go through the host bridge, only allowedHosts domains pass
en.plugin.s4: URL install has SSRF protection: private / loopback / non-http(s) rejected
en.plugin.ui-note: Components outside the whitelist and javascript: links are always rejected — plugins have no arbitrary HTML injection.
en.sdk.r1: Subscribe to message:new / recall / presence / conv:open / ui:action
en.sdk.r2: Send messages; objects are JSON-serialized automatically
en.sdk.r6: Host-mediated fetch, only allowedHosts domains pass
en.sdk.r7: Modify TDesign theme tokens, site-wide instant reskin
en.qs.title: Quick start
en.qs.sub: Two terminals, four commands, one complete ModernChat. The first registered account becomes the admin.
en.footer.line: An open-source, frontend-backend separated, plugin-first web chat platform.

en.mkt.title: Marketplace — ModernChat
en.mkt.desc: Browse the ModernChat plugin catalog: download a JS file and upload it to your instance. Every plugin runs in a sandbox, gets no JWT, and is enabled only after you confirm its permissions.
en.mkt.sub: Download a plugin JS file and upload it to your instance to install. Every plugin runs in a sandboxed iframe — no JWT, no DOM access, enabled only after you confirm the permission list.
en.mkt.empty: No plugins match. Try another keyword or category.
en.mkt.step1-d: Click "Download JS" on a card to get a plugin file (≤1MB).
en.mkt.step2-d: Chat page → "Plugins" in the sidebar → upload the file; uploading the same plugin again upgrades it.
en.mkt.step3-d: Review the permission list and confirm — it goes live immediately. Uninstall to return to plain text.
en.mkt.pub-d: Write one JS file declaring a manifest and its permissions to get listed here. See the plugin development guide, then submit a PR to plugins/examples/ in the repo — accepted plugins appear on this page.

zh.site.title: ModernChat — 插件优先的网页聊天平台
zh.site.desc: 开箱只有账号与纯文本聊天，图片、表情、主题、机器人、小游戏全部由可插拔的 JS 插件实现。前后端分离，Go + Vue 3，开源自托管。
zh.hero.h1:
插件优先的
网页聊天平台
zh.hero.sub: 开箱只有最朴素的账号 + 纯文本聊天；图片、表情、Markdown、暗色主题、机器人、小游戏——一切增强能力都来自可插拔的 JS 插件，卸掉即回到纯文本。
zh.hero.p1: 沙箱插件运行时：不碰 DOM、拿不到 JWT，权限清单确认后才启用
zh.hero.p2: 单实例支持 1 万+ WebSocket 在线，消息端到端 P99 < 100ms
zh.hero.p3: Docker Compose 一键起，一条命令从 Gitee 升级
zh.demo.title: 产品交流群
zh.demo.subtitle: 12 人 · 3 人在线
zh.demo.caption: ▶ 演示：纯文本消息 · 插件自定义消息卡片 · 插件一键切换暗色主题
zh.features.title: 功能特性
zh.features.sub: 内核尽量薄，一切增强皆插件。以下为开箱即用的内核能力。
zh.f1.d: 注册 / 登录 / 找回密码，bcrypt 散列，JWT 带 token_version 支持主动失效，封禁强制全端下线，自定义头像。
zh.f2.d: WebSocket 心跳 + 指数退避重连，已读回执、2 分钟撤回、"对方正在输入"、在线状态，断线重连自动补齐数据。
zh.f3.d: 统一会话模型：单聊幂等复用，群聊建 / 搜 / 加 / 退、踢人与群主转让，会话列表未读红点与分组筛选。
zh.f4.d: 沙箱 iframe 运行、描述式 UI 白名单渲染、权限清单确认、同名上传即升级，站长可全局下架任意插件。
zh.f5.d: 用户封禁 / 解封 / 随机重置密码，插件按名称聚合视图与全局下架，构建版本信息一目了然。
zh.f6.d: 结构化日志按天轮转，三档限流（Redis 可选共享配额），健康检查与版本接口，一条命令从 Gitee 升级。
zh.plugin.title: 插件系统：写一个 JS 文件，扩展整个网站
zh.plugin.sub: 每个插件是一个 ≤1MB 的 JS 文件，运行在 sandbox iframe 中，通过 postMessage 与主站通信，UI 一律以描述式 JSON 交由白名单组件渲染。
zh.plugin.s1: 插件不接触 DOM、拿不到 JWT、读不到主站存储
zh.plugin.s2: 安装时展示权限清单，用户确认后才启用
zh.plugin.s3: 网络请求经主站桥接，仅放行 allowedHosts 白名单域名
zh.plugin.s4: URL 安装有 SSRF 防护：拒绝私网 / 回环 / 非 http(s)
zh.plugin.ui-t: 描述式 UI：8 个白名单组件
zh.plugin.ui-note: 白名单外的组件与 javascript: 链接一律拒绝渲染——插件拿不到任意 HTML 注入能力。
zh.sdk.r1: 订阅 message:new / recall / presence / conv:open / ui:action
zh.sdk.r2: 发消息，对象自动 JSON 序列化
zh.sdk.r3: 自定义消息类型 → UI 描述
zh.sdk.r4: 提交侧边栏面板 UI 描述
zh.sdk.r5: 每插件独立命名空间存储（单值 ≤64KB）
zh.sdk.r6: 主站代为 fetch，仅放行 allowedHosts 域名
zh.sdk.r7: 修改 TDesign 主题令牌，全站即时换肤
zh.qs.title: 快速开始
zh.qs.sub: 两个终端、四条命令，跑起一个完整的 ModernChat。首个注册的账号自动成为站长。
zh.footer.line: 前后端分离、插件优先的开源网页聊天平台。

zh.mkt.title: 插件市场 — ModernChat
zh.mkt.desc: 浏览 ModernChat 插件目录：下载 JS 文件，上传到你的实例即可安装。每个插件都跑在沙箱里，拿不到 JWT、碰不到 DOM，权限清单确认后才启用。
zh.mkt.sub: 下载插件 JS 文件，在你的实例里上传即装。每个插件都运行在沙箱 iframe 中，拿不到 JWT、碰不到 DOM，权限清单确认后才启用。
zh.mkt.empty: 没有匹配的插件，换个关键词或分类试试。
zh.mkt.step1-d: 点击卡片上的「下载 JS」，得到一个 ≤1MB 的插件文件。
zh.mkt.step2-d: 聊天页 → 侧栏「插件」→ 上传文件；同一插件再次上传即升级。
zh.mkt.step3-d: 查看权限清单，确认后启用，立即生效。卸载即回到纯文本。
zh.mkt.pub-d: 写一个 JS 文件，声明 manifest 与所需权限，即可发布到这里。开发指南见插件开发文档，向仓库 plugins/examples/ 目录提交 PR，收录后展示在本页。
